orcamentos.usesPcMAndIs: Uses {quantity} pc · {width} × {height} m and is recalculated if the item changes.
orcamentos.ownSizeStaysAsIs: Own size: stays as is if the item changes. Use it for a single part, such as installation.
orcamentos.theCostEnteredHereIs: The cost entered here is used to calculate the sale price and create the bill to the supplier.
orcamentos.theQuoteScreenAndThe: The quote screen and the proposal show only the sale price.
orcamentos.enterTheCostToSee: Enter the cost to see the price suggested by the company markup.
orcamentos.whatTheProductIncludesWith: what the product includes, with the quantities of this sale
orcamentos.thisReportShowsWhatThe: This report shows what the item contains, without cost values.
orcamentos.costAndMarginAreIn: Cost and margin are in the sale's Expected result, for those allowed to see values.
orcamentos.itIsWhatExceedsThe: It is what exceeds the customer's credit limit: what is due today (the down payment or the upfront payment) only counts as paid once received. When approved, the sale stays in the ⚠️ On hold tab until Finance receives {amount}; then it becomes a work order.
orcamentos.approvalIsBlockedByThe: Approval is blocked by the customer's credit
orcamentos.anyoneAllowedToChangeThe: Anyone allowed to change the limit or unblock the customer does so in the customer record.
orcamentos.pngOrJpgUpTo: PNG or JPG up to 10MB - (4:3 ratio)
orcamentos.quoteAlreadyApprovedValuesCan: Quote already approved, values can't be edited
orcamentos.changeTheTotalValueUp: Change the total value up, down, or to round it. Down counts as a discount and your limit applies.
orcamentos.totalDiscountExceedsTheSalesperson: Total discount ({valor}%) exceeds the salesperson's limit ({maxDiscount}%). Reduce the discount to save.
orcamentos.withoutTheRAddedTo: Without the R$ {linesTotal} added to the item, which go into the final amount.
orcamentos.rOverTheBaseAmount: + R$ {surcharge}{surchargePercentText} over the base amount. It's built into the item amount and doesn't count as a discount.
orcamentos.noneRaiseTheTotalValue: None. Raise the total value to record a markup; it is built into the item value, with no separate line in the proposal.
orcamentos.thisCustomerRequiresPrepaymentThe: This customer requires prepayment. The sale becomes a work order, and goes into production, when Finance receives the total.
orcamentos.theSaleExceededTheCustomer: The sale exceeded the customer's credit limit. It becomes a work order when Finance receives what exceeds the limit.
orcamentos.toChangeTheSaleMove: To change the sale, move it back to draft. To give up, reject it: the ⚠️ Payment hold receivable is canceled with it.
orcamentos.paidInFullNowTo: {client} - {reference} · paid in full, now. To split or charge later, use a series that bills on the order.
orcamentos.theSaleJoinsThePoint: The sale joins the point of sale queue and is locked: the cashier collects payment and chooses the payment method. If anything changes later, add a new item or cancel and make another sale.
orcamentos.errorSendingTheSaleTo: Error sending the sale to the register
orcamentos.customerBlockedInTheRegistration: Customer blocked in the registration: this sale cannot be charged or sent to the register.
orcamentos.paymentNowOrAtThe: Payment: now or at the cash register
orcamentos.chargeInFullNowOr: Charge in full now, or send it to the cash register, where the cashier defines the payment method.
orcamentos.registeredCustomerWantsABoleto: Registered customer wants a boleto or to be invoiced?
orcamentos.theRefundWasRecordedAt: The refund was recorded at the register, with the reason and who made it.
orcamentos.paidAndDeliveredNothingMore: Paid and delivered. Nothing more to do here.
orcamentos.theCustomerPaysTheRemaining: The customer pays the remaining {remaining} on pickup.
orcamentos.theSaleIsLockedWhile: The sale is locked while it waits for payment. If anything changes, add a new item or cancel and make another sale.
orcamentos.thisQuoteHasAlreadyBeen: This quote has already been approved. To follow its progress, go to the work order
orcamentos.theWorkOrderHasAlready: The work order has already been created for this sale.
orcamentos.saleOnHoldWaitingFor: Sale on hold: waiting for {holdAmount} in Finance to become a work order
orcamentos.thisItemHasADeactivated: This item has a deactivated product:
orcamentos.theseItemsHaveADeactivated: These items have a deactivated product:
orcamentos.replaceOrRemoveTheItem: Replace or remove the item in Items to approve. Once approved, the quote would become a work order with a product the company no longer sells.
orcamentos.theWorkOrderIsCreated: The work order is created with the installments and the payment method, so they must be entered first.
orcamentos.thisCustomerRequiresPrepaymentThe2: This customer requires prepayment. The sale stays in the ⚠️ On hold tab and Finance receives {holdAmount} as a receivable marked ⚠️ Payment hold. When it is recorded as paid, the sale becomes a work order.
orcamentos.showTheDeadlineInThe: Show the deadline in the PDF as
orcamentos.freightIsnTPartOf: Freight isn't part of this sale
orcamentos.theQuickSaleAndThe: The quick sale and the items entered are deleted. They cannot be recovered afterwards.
orcamentos.theSaleItemsWereDuplicated: The sale items were duplicated into a new quote
orcamentos.theQuoteDidnTGo: The quote didn't go through checkout
orcamentos.theQuoteWentThroughCheckout: The quote went through checkout. What do you want to do now?
orcamentos.moveTheSaleBackTo: Move the sale back to draft?
orcamentos.doYouWantToReopen: Do you want to reopen this quote?
orcamentos.theSaleLeavesOnHold: The sale leaves On hold so it can be edited, and the ⚠️ Payment hold receivable in Finance is canceled. To approve it again, finish and approve it: the hold comes back with the new amounts.
orcamentos.confirmThatYouWantTo: Confirm that you want to reopen the quote.
orcamentos.theCommissionAmountOrPercentage: The commission amount or percentage is added to the final sale value.
orcamentos.theCommissionAmountOrPercentage2: The commission amount or percentage is paid out of the sale profit.
orcamentos.enterTheDownPaymentMethod: Enter the down payment method to continue.
orcamentos.setUpTheQuotePayment: Set up the quote payment terms
orcamentos.withThisDownPaymentPaid: With this down payment paid, the remaining balance fits within the customer's credit limit. Choose the payment method for the down payment and save. When approved, the sale stays on hold until Finance receives the down payment.
orcamentos.theTermsCanBeSet: The terms can be set, but this quote is not approved and generates no charge while the customer is blocked in the registration.
orcamentos.theAmountEnteredExceedsThe: The amount entered exceeds the available total. The last installment can't be negative.
orcamentos.theDownPaymentCanT: The down payment can't use up the entire total
orcamentos.theInstallmentAmountMustBe: The installment amount must be greater than zero
orcamentos.theQuoteMovesToRejected: The quote moves to Rejected. It is not deleted: it can be reopened later.{pendingNote}
orcamentos.tellUsWhyTheCustomer: Tell us why the customer did not close. The reason shows on the quote and in the lost-sales report.{pendingNote}
orcamentos.theItemIsRemovedFrom: The item is removed from the quote. This action can't be undone.
orcamentos.oneItemHasADeactivated: One item has a deactivated product
orcamentos.theQuoteCanTBe: . The quote can't be approved until the item is replaced or removed.
orcamentos.thisProductSCompositionHas: This product’s composition has not been approved yet: the item uses the catalogue price, without cost
orcamentos.markupDifferenceAboveTheBase: Markup: difference above the base price
orcamentos.recalculatedWhenTheItemSize: Recalculated when the item size changes
orcamentos.staysAsIsWhenThe: Stays as is when the item size changes
orcamentos.noStepsAtAllThe: No steps at all. The quote can proceed, but set up the steps later to get cost and production.
orcamentos.chooseTheCustomerRecordNot: Choose the customer record, not the quick sale walk-in customer
orcamentos.itIsNowAStandard: It is now a standard sale: fill in the payment terms and approve.
orcamentos.forTheRegisteredCustomerWho: For the registered customer who wants a boleto or to be invoiced. The counter only takes payment in full; in the standard sale you choose the payment terms, approve, and the boleto continues in the Cash flow.
orcamentos.seriesThatBillsOnThe: Series that bills on the order or on delivery
orcamentos.noActiveSeriesBillsOn: No active series bills on the order or on delivery. Create one in Settings › Sales › Sales series.
orcamentos.theSaleIsNoLonger: The sale is no longer a quick sale and gets the new series number.
orcamentos.youDonTHavePermission: You don't have permission to view this quote.
orcamentos.whatIsLeftOfThe: What is left of the sale after production cost, commission and taxes. Until production is logged, everything here is an estimate.
orcamentos.soldAtTheRegisteredPrice: Sold at the registered price: the cost is not calculated.
orcamentos.youDonTHavePermission2: You don't have permission to view this sale's result.
orcamentos.theCostMarginAndResult: The cost, margin and result of each sale.
orcamentos.pasteTheCustomerRequestAs: Paste the customer request as it came. The AI builds the draft with the products from your catalogue; you review and apply. Nothing is saved before that.
orcamentos.yourCompanyHasUsedThis: Your company has used this month’s assistant messages.
orcamentos.eGINeed500: E.g.: "I need 500 business cards 4/4 and a 1.20 x 0.80 banner by Friday"
orcamentos.whatHappenedAndWhenTo: {clientName} · {reference}. What happened and when to talk again: the quote shows up under "To follow up" on that day.
orcamentos.eGWillConfirmWith: E.g.: will confirm with the partner by Friday
orcamentos.withoutADateTheQuote: Without a date, the quote has no next contact and shows up that way in the Waiting tab.
orcamentos.whenToResumeTheConversation: When to resume the conversation with the customer and what was agreed. The quotation shows under "To follow up" on that day.
orcamentos.eGCallAfterThe: E.g. call after the customer talks to their partner
orcamentos.noContactLoggedYetThe: No contact logged yet. The first one counts: it keeps what the customer said and when to talk again.
orcamentos.selectACsvFileTo: Select a CSV file to import quotes in bulk
orcamentos.chooseTheVariantForThe: Choose the variant for the item's price and name.
orcamentos.howManySheetsTheItem: How many sheets the item uses: it takes the piece's final size plus bleed on both sides, sees how many fit on the sheet and adds the make-ready sheets.
orcamentos.quantityMustBeGreaterThan: Quantity must be greater than or equal to one
orcamentos.quantityMustBeAValid: Quantity must be a valid number
orcamentos.theStepIsRemovedFrom: The step is removed from the item. The steps that came after it now follow the previous ones.
orcamentos.productCreatedWhileEditingReview: Product created while editing. Review the build-up in Settings › Products before releasing it for sale.
orcamentos.forWhenTheProductDoesn: For when the product doesn't exist ready-made. Build the item following the production path: the build stays only in this quote.
orcamentos.whatTheCustomerWillReceive: What the customer will receive. It appears in the proposal, below the item name.
orcamentos.eachBoxIsAStep: Each box is a step of the item. Use the "+" after a box to add the next step.
orcamentos.clickABoxToSee: Click a box to see and change its resources.
orcamentos.withNoStepsTheItem: With no steps, the item is marked "Needs attention". The quote moves on, but with no cost or production.
orcamentos.startWithTheStepWhere: Start with the step where the item begins: design, printing, structure.
orcamentos.thePartBringsItsOwn: The part brings its own build-up. Open the box in the flow to see what's inside.
orcamentos.thisStepHasNoResources: This step has no resources. Fill it in with a registered process from the box menu.
orcamentos.theBoxStaysInThe: The box stays in the same place in the flow, with the same connections. What changes are the resources and the time.
orcamentos.whichItemDoYouWant: Which item do you want to add?
orcamentos.buildAnItemThatDoesn: Build an item that doesn't exist ready-made
orcamentos.serviceHiredFromASupplier: Service hired from a supplier for this sale only
orcamentos.searchForTheProductBy: Search for the product by name or filter by department
orcamentos.tryAnotherNameOrAnother: Try another name or another department.
orcamentos.noProductReleasedForSale: No product released for sale in this department.
orcamentos.aServiceHiredFromA: A service hired from a supplier for this sale only. When the quotation is approved, the payable to the supplier is created with the cost entered. The cost does not show on the quotation.
orcamentos.thisQuantityIsMultipliedBy: This quantity is multiplied by the item quantity
orcamentos.tierPriceStartingAtR: Tier price starting at {from}: R$ {valor} per sales unit.
orcamentos.thisProductSBuildUp: This product's build-up has not been approved yet: the quote fields and optional items show up here once it is approved.
orcamentos.whoTheCompanyBuysThis: Who the company buys this item from.
orcamentos.whenTheSaleIsApproved: When the sale is approved, the bill goes to this supplier. After that it cannot be changed here: change it on the bill.
orcamentos.writeTheTechnicalDescriptionOf: Write the technical description of this quote item.
orcamentos.atThisPriceTheQuote: At this price, the quote discount is {valor}% over the catalog price, above the seller limit ({maxDiscount}%). Raise the price to save.
orcamentos.piecesPerSheetInEach: Pieces per sheet in each orientation
orcamentos.eGCustomerBringsThe: E.g.: customer brings the artwork as a PDF
orcamentos.youDonTHavePermission3: You don't have permission to view the quotes page.

ordensDeServico.enterTheReasonItShows: Enter the reason. It shows on the service order and in the losses report.
ordensDeServico.askedToRedoThisWork: {requestedByName} asked to redo this work order: {reason}. Production or material write-off already exists, so someone else approves.
ordensDeServico.theCurrentWorkOrderIs: The current work order is canceled and the new one starts as a draft copy, to edit what changed. What was already produced moves to the new one by item; nothing is deleted.
ordensDeServico.whatWasAlreadyProducedAnd: What was already produced and does not fit the new one
ordensDeServico.whatWasPaidStaysOn: What was paid stays on the canceled work order; moving it to the new one is manual.
ordensDeServico.theApprovalWasAlreadyComplete: The approval was already complete: nothing was missing.
ordensDeServico.toStoreTheJobFiles: To store the job files: images, the print PDF, the project. Anyone who can see this WO can see them.
ordensDeServico.eachStageFilesStayOn: Each stage files stay on the board, for those with access to it.
ordensDeServico.youDonTHavePermission: You don't have permission to view this work order.
ordensDeServico.selectACsvFileTo: Select a CSV file to import work orders in bulk
ordensDeServico.noWorkOrdersAvailableFor: No work orders available for export
ordensDeServico.selectAReasonAndConfirm: Select a reason and confirm whether you want to cancel the sale
ordensDeServico.youDonTHavePermission2: You don't have permission to view the work orders page.

vendasDeHoje.noSalesInThisStatus: No sales in this status today.
vendasDeHoje.youDoNotHavePermission: You do not have permission to view sales.
